question: For one batch of real requests, how long does the library take with a throughput-based track read model, and what SLO is reasonable?
trace: Fujitsu SYSTOR'17 VDI, 2016-02-22, LUNs 0,1,2,3,4,6, reads only
library: 640 slots, 1 TB platters, 1 reader, 8 Zone shuttles, B1 Silica scheduler, contention hold 0.5 s

read_model.source: Silica SOSP'23: a track is the minimum read unit (sec. 5) of O(100) data + O(10) redundancy sectors (sec. 5), each sector upwards of 100 kB (sec. 3); drives scale in multiples of 30 MB/s up to 210 MB/s (sec. 3). track_seek_s is an assumption.

batch.note: a batch = every read in [start, start + interval) of the trace, issued at t=0; no sampling, real locality kept
